`interface IAudioSource`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`AlAudioSource`](/reference/base-openal/alaudiosource/), [`SnapshotAudioSource`](/reference/testing/snapshotaudiosource/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.audio` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IAudioSource.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/audio/IAudioSource.java)

One stream of 16-bit samples that the video player fills ahead of the clock and plays.

## Description

The video player calls every method on the render thread.

## Learn more

- [Audio bridge](/build/bridges/audio/#required)

### write

`void write(short[] samples)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Appends interleaved samples to the queue of the source.
A playing source whose queue ran dry plays again.

### isPlaying

`boolean isPlaying()` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

### getBufferedSamples

`int getBufferedSamples()` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>
